sections.text_helper: Section 39.14.56 "DCMIPP Pipe1 demosaicing configuration register (DCMIPP_P1DMCR)" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1942.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x870
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bit 31 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 30:28 EDGE[2:0]: Strength of the edge detection
0x0: No edge detection, pure linear interpolation
0x1 to 0x7: Algorithm strength, respectively 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24
Bit 27 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 26:24 LINEH[2:0]: Strength of the horizontal line detection
0x0: No horizontal line detection, pure linear interpolation
0x1 to 0x7: Algorithm strength, respectively 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24
Bit 23 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 22:20 LINEV[2:0]: Strength of the vertical line detection
0x0: No vertical line detection, pure linear interpolation
0x1 to 0x7: Algorithm strength, respectively 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24
Bit 19 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 18:16 PEAK[2:0]: Strength of the peak detection
0x0: No peak detection, pure linear interpolation
0x1 to 0x7: Algorithm strength, respectively 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24
Bits 15:3 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 2:1 TYPE[1:0]: Raw Bayer type
0x0: RGGB
0x1: GRBG
0x2: GBRG
0x3: BGGR
Bit 0 ENABLE:
0: Bypass
1: Enable demosaicing
